text:
rafael: quick proposal — unify client-facing error surface into three buckets (Client, Transient, System) + an internal routing flag for fallback decisions. keeping HTTP 4xx/5xx but add canonical \"r_code\" strings in response bodies. thoughts?
anya: interested. can you sketch how this maps to current quota/limit errors? we have a bunch of legacy 429 variants. :thinking:
rafael: yeah — map all quota hits -> Client with r_code: \"quota_exceeded\". 429 still returned for rate, but body r_code is canonical. this lets console grouping + routing rules use r_code, not status.
sara: love the routing flag idea. do you mean something like `route_hint: \"fallback:prefer-similar\"` so proxy can pick cheaper model variant?
rafael: exactly. small example payload: ```json
{"status":429,"r_code":"quota_exceeded","message":"quota exceeded for model.x","route_hint":"fallback:lower_tier_if_available","retry_after":60}
```
tom: minor concern — SDKs that parse by status will ignore r_code. we should add guidance to SDKs to prioritize r_code when present and keep status as a fallback. also add telemetry boolean `r_code_used:true` so console can show adoption.
meera: +1 to telemetry flag. We need consistent tag names for dashboards: `error.bucket`, `error.r_code`, `routing.hint`, `retryable` so SLO pages can be filtered.
anya: how about client UX copy? if we show \"quota_exceeded\" to customers that's noisy. console should display friendly text mapping from r_code via i18n. r_code is stable contract, friendly copy is configurable per org.
rafael: good call. r_code stays machine-only; Console uses mapping table for user text and outage banners. also use r_code for alarm rules — e.g., alert on high rate of `system.memory_pressure` r_code even if status 503 or 502 vary.
sara: rollout plan? we need canary on SDK + server. propose: 1) emit r_code only in a % of responses behind flag 2) SDKs roll to prefer r_code for parsing 3) Console reads r_code in telemetry and surfaces counts 4) make routing rules opt-in to use r_code.
tom: add a linter in eng-releases that fails if new endpoints return unmapped r_codes. prevents accidental new code sprawl.
meera: for telemetry we should also tag `routing.decision` — e.g., whether the request got routed to fallback. that helps debug false positives in cost dashboards.
anya: small UX ask — provide a per-route sample mapping view in Console where an operator can click an r_code and see which endpoints return it and example payloads. helps support teams.
rafael: will draft the RFC with mapping table + migration steps. one more note: prefer r_code namespaced like `quota.exceeded` `auth.invalid_key` to avoid collisions.
infra-bot: deploy-check: lint for r_code namespacing passed on branch r/code-errors-1746 — 0 warnings. :white_check_mark:
meera: perfect. i'll add dashboard templates for the new tags.
tom: SGTM, i'll file an SDK issue to prefer r_code parsing and add compatibility tests. :thumbsup:
rafael: thanks all — i'll post the RFC link here when ready.
